title: Asymptotic Geometry of Four-Dimensional Steady Solitons
summary: In this paper we study the behavior of the scalar curvature at infinity on complete noncompact steady gradient Ricci solitons. In dimension four, we assume that the canonical Ricci flow induced by the soliton is a weak $κ$-solution and that the soliton is not isometric to the Bryant soliton. In this setting, we identify the two edges of the soliton and prove that the scalar curvature decays at a linear rate away from these edges.
